messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] problem with GenomeWideSNP_5 ugp and ufl
parts:
Did you unzip? Could also be corrupt downloads. See if the UGP and
UFL files show up in the following list:

path <- "annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_5";
fs <- GenericDataFileSet$fromFiles(path);
x <- unname(lapply(fs, getDetails));
print(x);

If they do, show us your list for comparison.

/Henrik
